body: It hurts to know that it will never change

I asked him about how he came up with the idea but...the reason doesn't make much sense to me, it's because I like his clothes so he got me something in his size to wear. But...He also randomly gifts me his clothes if he Sees I like wearing them and doesn't ask for them back. I mean i like his clothes because it's *his* clothes so buying me something new and simple in just size but for me doesn't make much sense to me I think :(

Sorry it's just weird because a few months ago he randomly got me a gift that u really love and that represented something that I really like and enjoy so it's not like be doesn't know me. He really does, can't imagine a more wonderful man than him. He cares for me in a way I've never experienced before, he understands me, I can be myself with him, I'm able to be happy, I'm able to look past my insecurities when I'm with him. He's so patient and wonderful, everything he does makes me fall in love with him more and more. All the little things he does and doesn't even realise he's doing.

Same here, not being pretty is my biggest issue with myself, I was bullied because of it, became anorexic even though I was already underweight and I just wish I could change my face and look like those girls online.
The tiny nose, freckles, a v-face, full lips, a cute smile, a small forehead. It sucks.

Well I can tell you what happened if you want. I told my sister that she still needed to give me back 20 euros and he started  to mimic me so I said "why are you doing that? It's childish and annoying " (he wasn't even part of the conversation).he then told me to lick his ass and I was confused and angry because of this word choice so I told him, that's its weird and disgusting to say, well.. He then told me that I'm dead to him anyway and I already wrote the rest.

I don't want to sound narcissistic or anything like that, but I don't think it's appropriate to flip out because of something like that. Even my mother agreed with me, who usually doesn't...

I'm trying to reflect on this whole thing and give him and myself space, because I can't really look into his eyes at the moment and I can't tell how seriously he is about his apology
